title: Nvidia Faces First Earnings Test Since Huang’s Exit
summary: Nvidia reports for the first time since Jensen Huang's surprise departure, putting its 70% growth outlook and the AI trade in focus. JPMorgan Asset Management's Stephanie Aliaga argues compute demand remains intact and notes Anthropic's IPO could give public investors a new window into AI economics.

title: Nvidia Scandal Has Raised ‘Red Flags,’ California AG Says
summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said his office is looking into aspects of the scandal engulfing Nvidia and its former CEO Jensen Huang, citing 'red flags'.

title: Why startups still go public, eventually
summary: The Economist argues that costly regulation is not a big deterrent to IPOs, and that startups still go public eventually.

title: Salario mínimo subiría a 10,700 pesos al mes en 2027: IMCP
summary: El IMCP estima que el salario mínimo general subiría entre 12% y 13% en 2027, a entre 352 y 355 pesos diarios, unos 10,700 pesos al mes. La Conasami sesionará de forma permanente la próxima semana y deberá definir el aumento a más tardar el 1 de diciembre.

title: Jensen Huang reconoce que está dispuesto a regresar como CEO de Nvidia: ‘Será un honor volver’
summary: Jensen Huang admitió la responsabilidad de sus errores y dijo que volvería como director ejecutivo de Nvidia si el Consejo lo considera lo mejor para accionistas y empleados. Es su primer mensaje desde que dimitió el jueves pasado.

title: Nvidia to Face Its New AI Reality
summary: Nvidia reports without Jensen Huang as the tech trade faces fresh pressure, while Home Depot kicks off retail earnings and Disney beats expectations. Demand for Anthropic's IPO is pushing pricing to the top of the range or higher.

title: OpenAI Unveils New Astra AI Model After Scrapping Prior Release
summary: OpenAI is releasing a new version of its most advanced Astra AI model. It comes nearly two months after the company scrapped a prior update to establish stronger safeguards.

title: JPMorgan Warns Leveraged-Loan Defaults Set to Double in 2027
summary: JPMorgan analysts expect leveraged-loan defaults to more than double to 4.5% next year, levels not seen since 2024, as heavily indebted companies face mounting financial pressure.

title: Peso abre con ganancias... pero espera reporte de Nvidia: ¿Cómo opera el tipo de cambio HOY?
summary: El peso inicia la sesión con ganancias y el tipo de cambio opera alrededor de 18.50 pesos por dólar. El mercado espera nueva información económica y el reporte de Nvidia.

title: Mark Walter’s Largest Insurer Sees Sales Plunge After US Probe
summary: Annuity sales at Mark Walter's largest insurance company dropped after a federal investigation into the firm's accounting practices became public.

title: Venta de acciones tech golpea a bolsas globales: Nvidia y Anthropic influyen en extender caída
summary: Las bolsas globales cayeron ante la cautela por los resultados de Nvidia, la expectativa del debut bursátil de Anthropic y las dudas persistentes sobre la inteligencia artificial. El Nasdaq retrocedió 2.49%, el S&P 500 1.92% y el Dow Jones 1.41%.

title: Compute Futures Aim to Hedge AI Risks
summary: Silicon Data and Compute Exchange CEO Carmen Li explains how compute futures could let financiers and AI companies hedge shifting GPU costs and supply risks.

title: 2026 is Year Where the 'AI Boom Became Debt Finance,' Says Wigglesworth
summary: FT columnist Robin Wigglesworth argues 2026 is the year the AI boom became a debt-financed story. He discusses his book "A Fabulous Debt" and how bond markets have evolved.

title: Consumer Strain Meets AI’s Reality Check
summary: Meredith Whitney says consumers face tough choices as housing and food costs stay high and lending tightens. She also discusses questions over chip demand, delayed data centers and circular financing, and whether AI risks could spread through banks and the broader economy.

title: Top AI Models Regularly Identify Civilians as Military Targets in Tests
summary: An independent research report found that advanced AI models in simulated scenarios regularly misidentified civilians, ambulances, surrendering soldiers and a school as military targets. The findings add to concerns about model risk and AI governance.

title: SpaceX Debt for AI Chips to Hit Market as Soon as This Week
summary: SpaceX may begin part of a $40 billion debt sale to fund purchases of AI chips as soon as this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Ciberespías usan facturas como caballos de Troya para infiltrar grandes empresas y gobiernos
summary: Ciberespías están usando facturas como caballos de Troya para infiltrar grandes empresas y gobiernos, según Expansión. La nota destaca el riesgo de ciberseguridad en procesos administrativos cotidianos.

title: Es México campeón... ¡de la informalidad!
summary: México tiene una tasa de informalidad laboral 6.2 veces más alta que el promedio de las economías avanzadas, según datos del Inegi y la OIT.

title: Adeuda 388 mmdp Pemex a la banca
summary: Pemex debe 388 mil millones de pesos a decenas de bancos y entidades financieras de EU, México y otros países, según su más reciente reporte financiero.

title: Con cambios, Caputo retoma plan de ARS$2 billones para incentivar un repunte del crédito hipotecario
summary: El gobierno de Milei realizará la tercera licitación de plazos fijos para bancos con fondos del FGS de la ANSES, por hasta ARS$2 billones, para impulsar el crédito hipotecario. Introdujo cambios para incentivar la demanda, incluyendo un mayor margen para que los bancos destinen los fondos a distintas operaciones.

title: Leak of 15mn Deutsche Bank files exposes systemic failures
summary: A leak of 15 million Deutsche Bank files — emails, internal probes and other documents — exposes systemic failures at the lender. The documents shed new light on the career and leadership of CEO Christian Sewing.

title: Modern and Mexican: Mario Pani’s CUPA Housing Complex in Mexico City
summary: In 1947 Mario Pani proposed a 13-story complex with more than a thousand apartments and extensive green and communal spaces instead of 200 houses for government employees in Colonia del Valle. Drawing on Le Corbusier, the CUPA complex became a landmark of modern Mexican housing.

title: Presenta Sheinbaum el Plan México ante empresarios de APEC
summary: Sheinbaum presentó el Plan México ante empresarios de APEC y afirmó que el país ofrece certidumbre para invertir y un modelo propio de desarrollo.

title: Anthropic Faces a Longer Wait Than SpaceX to Join Indexes
summary: Anthropic's planned IPO could draw billions of dollars from index-tracking funds. However, the AI startup may have to wait longer than SpaceX did to join two major stock benchmarks.

title: Bartleby newsletter: Why you weren’t invited to that meeting
summary: The Economist's Bartleby columnist Andrew Palmer writes about the benefits of skip-level meetings.

title: Anthropic’s giant IPO puts the heat on OpenAI
summary: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO is raising pressure on OpenAI, with coding agents emerging as big business. The piece asks what comes next for AI labs after the coding-agent boom.
